name: pointer-capture-retarget
observable: index of the brightest rail button over a sampled touch sequence (a single frozen frame is also non-zero, so a presence check cannot express this)
source_note: docs/solutions/ui-bugs/alphabet-rail-pointer-capture-click-retarget-no-highlight.md -- setPointerCapture on pointerdown retargets the subsequent click to the rail nav, so closest('[data-letter]') returns null and the highlight never runs. Verified with 12 real touch moves over USB, A/B/A: deployed 0/12 frames lit, patched 12/12, deployed-return 0/12.
